name: the-editing-table-platform
description: Full-stack React, Express, and MongoDB foundation for The Editing Table.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w server"
scripts.dev:clean: npm run kill:ports && npm run dev
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run healthcheck -w server
